text:
Amelia: Heads-up — Suncrest Health (private VPC) rollout ready for scheduling. Need single-slot dedicated slice cutover and version pining guidance. Change window we're targeting: Wed 02:00-04:00 UTC. Can we confirm KMS compatibility and rollback plan?
Deploy-Bot: Staged release available: redwood/serve:v2.3.1-dedicated -> slices: suncrest-prod-1 (canary) then suncrest-prod-2. See /deploy 2598765432 for details. :rocket:
Josh: quick note — customer uses an HSM-backed KMS with stricter envelope keys. v2.3.1 changed the KMS client timeout defaults; we've seen failures in preflight for KMS handshake in lab.
Ravi: omg ok. Did the internal preflight catch that? Any error logs?
Josh: logs show: `kms: handshake timeout after 8s` on initial bucket open. We've got a patch in v2.3.2 but not validated for Dedicated yet.
Leah: Given that, recommend pinning Suncrest to the last verified image (v2.3.0) for Dedicated. We can release v2.3.1 to hosted customers still.
CloudOps: I can schedule the window but need explicit confirmation if we should pin image in the rollout config. Also need approval for maintenance notice to customer (30m pre-open).
Amelia: OK — proposal: pin Suncrest to `redwood/serve:v2.3.0-dedicated` for this cutover, run canary on suncrest-prod-1, then switch to v2.3.2 once KMS handshake patch validated in private env next week.
SRE-Bot: Canary health thresholds: error rate <0.5% 5m rolling, p95 latency <180ms. Autoscale events allowed <=2 in 10m. If threshold breached -> auto-rollback.
Ravi: I'll run an extended KMS smoke in a staging VPC tomorrow morning and share logs. If green, we can then plan v2.3.2 promotion.
Leah: Confirmed — notify customer that the upgrade will be to v2.3.0 (no behavioral changes) to avoid risk. Draft notice: "Planned maintenance Wed 02:00–04:00 UTC. Brief traffic reroute; no expected downtime. We'll validate KMS handshakes and revert if issues detected."
Amelia: Rollback commands pinned here for ops:
```
# rollback to pinned image
kubectl -n suncrest set image deploy/redwood-inference redwood=redwood/serve:v2.3.0-dedicated
kubectl rollout status deploy/redwood-inference -w
# if further issues: scale to zero and restore last-known-good snapshot
kubectl scale deploy/redwood-inference --replicas=0
kubectl apply -f snapshots/suncrest/last-good.yaml
```
CloudOps: Scheduled Wed 02:00 UTC -> 02:40 UTC for canary, 02:40 -> 03:10 for progressive shift, 03:10 -> 03:40 final validation, 03:40 -> 04:00 buffer/rollback. Maintenance notice queued for customer; sending 30m prior.
Deploy-Bot: Acknowledged. Deployment plan updated: image pinned -> `redwood/serve:v2.3.0-dedicated`. Canary slice suncrest-prod-1. Canary timeout 15m. Auto-rollback hook enabled per SRE thresholds.
Josh: I'll stand by to patch the KMS client and re-run preflight for v2.3.2 in the private stack on Mon. If results look good, we can schedule a follow-up minor version promotion.
Amelia: Thanks team. Final decision: pin to v2.3.0 for this window, proceed with CloudOps schedule, Ravi to confirm staging KMS smoke by EOD tomorrow. If any change, update this thread. :white_check_mark:
